title: Constructed and uniquely representative-normalized scalar tensor realization
statement: For a finite commutative ring R, scheme T, and any intrinsic tensor model a [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], the specified scalar realization E [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] has a unique natural isomorphism t:E(M tensor_fixed^L N)≅a(E M,E N) normalized on flat-term K-flat cochain representatives. The normalization uses the actual ordinary sheafification tensor isomorphism, its signed-total comparison, the exact-functor localization factor and the given a.representative. These constructions, the flat-term K-flat class and the inverse fixed localization tensorator are explicitly defined; there is no arbitrary choice of tensor data.

proof.text: Build the signed-total natural comparison from an ordinary additive tensor equivalence while coefficient category and intrinsic ring sheaf are abstract. Apply normalized representative descent. Then specialize to the specified associated-module-sheaf realization, its exact derived functor and the supplied intrinsic tensor model, using preservation of flat K-flat representatives and fully faithful resolving restriction. The intrinsic derived category is its published standard localization.

def finiteScalarTensorRealization
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel T (proEtaleConstantRing T R)) :
    (postcompose₂.obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence T R).functor).obj
        (ProEtale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) T) ≅
      (((whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence T R).functor).obj
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence T R).functor).obj (curry.obj a.tensor)
